collection.title: Fiat Croma 2005 to 2010 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: All of the following wiper blades will fit a Fiat Croma 2005 to 2010 model which requires a 24" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 17" for the passengers side. This model uses the Side Pin arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm.
